🍌 Banana POD Studio v3.3

Printify Workplace • Swatches • Multi-DPI

Cached Products: T-Shirt, Dress, Tumbler
Brand Swatches: 5 Decided Colors
Creative Pipeline
🏢 Back to Multi-Website Control Center
Active Trend Queue (1 at a time):
Batch #1 🧠 Memory Rules Learned: 6

Step 1A: All Exported Trends + Shared 10-Dimension Filter + Imported Path A Buzzwords & Hashtags

• Shared 10-Dimension Filtration Rule (Requirement #5): Filter all incoming trends here in Banana POD Studio using the exact same 10-Dimension Slicer as the Multi-Website App (Locale, Place, Trend Kind, Niche, Source, Multi-Platform Rise, Demographics, Age, Gender & Time).
• Path A Buzzwords & Hashtags Synced: Every trend card below carries its 💬 Buzzwords, #️⃣ Hashtags, 🔍 Keywords, Win Probability %, and Date-Wise Schedule from Path A.

📊 How Trend Kind Decides Launch Quota: 🎄 Festival/Macro → Minimum 12 Launch Ideas 🌿 Evergreen Niche → Minimum 7 Launch Ideas ⚡ Micro-Trend → Minimum 4 Launch Ideas
Showing Trends

Step 1B: 30 Design Ideas + LLM 5-Tier Analysis

• Slogan Only = Just the slogan  |  Graphic Only = 1 clear visual line  |  Graphic + Text = Slogan + 1 clear line.
• Click 🔍 Run LLM Analysis to score every idea into Must, Good Chances, Maybe, Later, or Nay with a collapsible explanation dropdown.

LLM Analysis Tabs:

💎 Unearthed Treasures (Saved "Hold for Later" Ideas Vault)

Pinned right under Step 1. Whenever you select multiple ideas saved for later, clicking the button below sends them straight to Step 2 (Working Now — Create Drafts).

Step 2: Working Now — Tinder Drafts (Rework In-Place OR Reject + Brand Swatches)

• Choose or lock the Brand Color Swatch for each graphic right here—it carries automatically to Storyboard #2 and the Actual Product Mockups.
• Includes both ⚡ Rework Right Now (in-place v1→v2 regeneration) AND 🗑️ Reject Draft (removes from Working Now & checks minimum launch quota).

Step 3: Storyboard #1 — First-Round Graphics Only (Totality Check)

Shows only the graphics/slogans just created in Step 2 side-by-side so you can verify how they sit together in totality. Flag any graphic that clashes and click Rework—locked graphics stay 100% untouched.

Step 4: Storyboard #2 — Simulated Printify Product Creator Workplace

Exact Printify editing controls for each product in your Brand Product Set: Print Area Switcher (Front/Back/Label), Center H/V, Fit to Area, Flip H/V, Safe Bleed Grid, Brand Color Swatches, per-product ↺ Reset Values, and 🗑️ Reject Design (if a design doesn't look good on physical products even after rework, rejecting it blocks it from Storyboard #3).

Select Design to Edit on Printify Workplace:

Step 4B: Actual Product with Placed Graphic & All Printify Mockups

Inspect the Actual Realistic Product with your Placed Graphic alongside all 4 Printify Camera Angles. If a design still does not look good on the actual product mockups even after rework, click 🗑️ Reject This Design so it does not move forward into Storyboard #3.

Inspecting Actual Product & Printify Mockup Angles for Design:

Step 5: Storyboard #3 — First-Draft LLM Photography (People, Pets, Studio Product), Carousels, Reels, Stories & Web

• 📸 Realistic LLM Photography First Drafts (Social & Web Tabs): Choose 🧑 People (Realistic LLM Model), 🐾 Pets + Product, or 📸 Actual Product Studio Photography on any card.
• ✅ LGTM / 🔄 Needs Rework / 🗑️ Reject + Rule Scope: Give feedback on any first-draft mockup, toggle "📌 Rule for this graphic only" (vs. long-term Brand Memory), and rework in-place or reject.
• 🛡️ Approved Designs Only: Any design rejected in Step 2, Step 4, or Step 4B is blocked from Storyboard #3, and any mockup rejected here is excluded from Step 6.

💡 Recommended Pipeline Architecture (Hybrid 2-Stage High-Res Flow — Why First-Draft Photography Review Happens Here in Step 5 BEFORE Step 6):
Stage A (Right After Step 4B): Once your design & Printify placement pass Step 4B, we immediately lock the crisp 300 DPI Graphic Print Master so the artwork composited onto the person's shirt/dress/tumbler is razor-sharp.
Stage B (Here in Step 5 — BEFORE Step 6 Final Social/Web High-Res Export): Because Social & Website mockups generate realistic LLM scenes (🧑 People, 🐾 Pets, 📸 Studio Product), we generate fast 96 DPI First Drafts here first. You mark each ✅ LGTM, 🔄 Needs Rework (with optional 📌 Rule for this graphic only), or 🗑️ Reject. Then Step 6 renders final high-res files (2048×2048 WebP, 1080×1920, 1080×1350) ONLY for your ✅ LGTM mockups — saving 60–80% GPU compute and never upscaling a rejected pose!
Inspecting Storyboard #3 (Approved Designs Only):
🎠 Segment 1: Multi-Product Carousel Bundle Builder (LLM Suggested / Manual / Collaborative) 5 Bundled Slides
Bundle Multiple Products & Angles into One Swipeable Carousel (1080×1080 & 1080×1350):
A carousel needs more than 1 product! Choose how to bundle your brand products across slides:
🎬 Segment 2: Reels & TikTok Multi-Pic Sequence Builder (Cannot Be 1 Pic — LLM Suggests 6 Pics) 6 Pics (9.0s Loop)
🤖 LLM Pacing Recommendation: 6 Pics @ 1.5s/cut = 9.0s High-Retention Beat-Synced Reel (1080×1920 9:16)
Reels cannot have just 1 pic. Choose the number of pics below or collaborate with the LLM on each keyframe:
📲 Segment 3: Multi-Upload Stories Sequence Planner (LLM Suggested, Manual, or Both) 4 Daily Story Uploads
Multi-Upload 24h Stories Sequence (Morning Hook → Midday Reveal → Bundle Match → Evening CTA Link Sticker):
Stories are uploaded multiple times across the day. Pick your upload count and mode (LLM, Manual, or Both):
🖼️ Segment 4: Social Tab — First-Draft LLM Photography (🧑 People, 🐾 Pets, 📸 Studio Product • ✅ LGTM / 🔄 Rework / 🗑️ Reject) 5 Social First-Draft Mockups
📢 Segment 5: Additive Paid Ad Creatives — First-Draft LLM Photography (✅ LGTM / 🔄 Rework / 🗑️ Reject) Toggle OFF (0 Ads)
🌐 Segment 6: Web Tab — Storefront First-Draft LLM Photography (🧑 People, 🐾 Pets, 📸 Studio Product • ✅ LGTM / 🔄 Rework / 🗑️ Reject) 4 Website First-Draft Mockups

Step 6: Resolution & DPI Verification Matrix + Compile Final Creatives

Not every creative needs to be 300 DPI! We verify and generate each creative at its exact industry-standard resolution and DPI: 300 DPI ONLY for Physical Printify Print Master Files, and 72 DPI for Website WebP & Social Media sRGB Creatives.

Creative Category Target Use Resolution & Dimensions Verified DPI Format & Color Profile
🖨️ Printify Physical Print Master Files Direct-to-Garment (DTG) / Sublimation Physical Printing 4500×5400 px (Tee), 4800×6600 px (Dress), 2775×2400 px (Tumbler) 300 DPI (Print Master Only) Lossless Transparent PNG (sRGB) / Crisp Vector SVG
🌐 Website Storefront Mockups & Banners PDP Zoom, Collection Grid, Seasonal Hero Banner, Cart 2048×2048 px (PDP), 1200×1600 px (Grid), 1920×800 px (Hero), 800×800 px (Cart) 72 DPI (Fast Core Web Vitals LCP) Optimized Lossy/Lossless WebP (<180 KB)
📱 Organic Social Posts + Carousels + Reels + Stories Multi-Product Carousels, Multi-Pic Reels, Multi-Upload Stories, Pins 1200×1500 px, 1080×1080 px, 1080×1920 px, 1000×1500 px 72 DPI (Screen-Native sRGB) sRGB PNG / H.264 MP4 Reel
📢 Additive Paid Ad Creatives (Toggle-Controlled) Meta Feed/Story/Link Ads, Pinterest Promoted, TikTok Spark 1080×1080, 1080×1350, 1080×1920, 1200×628, 1000×1500 Skipped (Toggle OFF) Ad-Safe sRGB PNG (<20% text overlay)
